g: (video games, slang, derogatory) Synonym of Xbox.
(slang, derogatory, video games) A slavish supporter of the Xbox range of video game consoles; an Xbox fanboy.
(video games, trademark) Any of the home consoles in Microsoft's Xbox product line, especially the original Xbox.
(intransitive, video games, informal) To play a video game using an Xbox home console.
(informal) An owner of a Xbox video game console.
